revision: Recessed About Me bay, no Workshop, frontward straight bridge, blue optical table

critics.assessment: Landing paving is continuous, projecting rail ends are gone, and the bridge joins the bay cleanly. The forward island attachment, straight approach, recessed cave room, and Workshop removal all read clearly.

Continuous paving covers the former black landing artifact, and rails terminate cleanly at posts. Workshop removed; About Me recessed into rock with no separate roof or car; subdued translucent blue holotable with a broad sloped ring.

iterations: Removed the complete Workshop collection, including generic props and its separate nameplate; removed the rear walkway and closed its cave opening.
Carved a vaulted alcove from approved terrain and removed the separate About Me roof. Replaced the bright table center with a hollow blue optical chamber and a steeper dark control annulus.
Moved the straight bridge departure farther toward the viewer, from -30 to -44 degrees, and strengthened faint submerged table reticles.

Repaired the landing identified by both critics: extended its level section, separated overlapping floor surfaces by 0.006 units, and joined each bridge guardrail to the exact receiving perimeter intersection.
